name: trig
code:
import cmath
z = 1 + 1j
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.sin(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.sin(z))[1], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.cos(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.cos(z))[1], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.tan(z))[0], 6))
print(round(cmath.polar(cmath.tan(z))[1], 6))

name: real_hyper
code:
import cmath
p = cmath.polar(cmath.asinh(1))
print(round(p[0], 10))
q = cmath.polar(cmath.acosh(2))
print(round(q[0], 10))
r = cmath.polar(cmath.atanh(0.5))
print(round(r[0], 10))

name: real_branch
code:
import cmath
print(cmath.acosh(0))
print(cmath.asin(2))
print(cmath.acos(2))
p = cmath.polar(cmath.atanh(2))
print(round(p[0], 10))
print(round(p[1], 10))
